title: Debug ordering · variation 2
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point

points: An algorithm specifies precise steps; a program expresses a procedure in a programming language.
Identify inputs, processing and outputs. Trace intermediate state and check termination.
The register game is a small instruction language for algorithm practice, not C.
lesson.title: Algorithms

objective: Debug ordering: Repair the reversed arithmetic instructions in the starter. add 11, then double. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 2, operand 11.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
